{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with any missing values in the two variables of interest
complete_data = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute the Pearson correlation
correlation = complete_data['flipper_length_mm'].corr(complete_data['body_mass_g'])

# Print only the correlation value, as required
print(correlation)"}
